verdict.rationale: Orrick documents a dedicated Cyber, Privacy & Data Innovation Group that helps technology companies "address global compliance requirements and reduce cyber risk," with partners recognized for incident response. A Privacy-in-a-Box offering also addresses compliance with the "fast-evolving legal landscape" for data. missing for 10: no evidence naming GDPR, CCPA or India's DPDP Act specifically, no detail on jurisdiction-specific privacy coverage (the India page makes no privacy mention), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the practice.
